blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video generators and video-based world models can synthesize plausible visual trajectories, but long-horizon procedural tasks require generation to adapt to what has actually been produced. A model must determine the next action from its generated state, execute that action, and recognize when the task is complete. Open-loop generation cannot adapt to execution outcomes, while existing closed-loop systems often rely on pretrained executors or indirect verification. This leaves a gap between deciding an action and successfully realizing it. We formulate procedural video generation as \emph{closed-loop task execution in visual world space} and introduce \textbf{WorldGuide}. Given only an initial image and a task goal, WorldGuide predicts an atomic action, generates its corresponding video clip, and uses the generated result to select the next action or terminate. The Planner and Executor are trained on the same step-level procedural demonstrations: the Planner learns to predict the next atomic action or task completion from visual progress, while the Executor is directly trained to realize the predicted actions. Hierarchical visual memory maintains state across long-horizon execution with bounded history token cost. Due to the lack of step-level action-video supervision for joint planner-executor training, we introduce \textbf{WorldGuide Bench}: approximately 59K step-annotated videos across 245 tasks and 27 procedural categories. WorldGuide achieves a 33.33\% Task Success on \textbf{WorldGuide-Bench}, compared with 29.90\% for the strong recent video model MiniMax-H3, even though MiniMax-H3 receives reference action plans, and achieves 47.69\% on \textbf{VideoCraft-Bench} compared with 32.73\% for MiniMax-H3 under goal-only conditioning. These results demonstrate the importance of coupling planning with learned execution for goal-directed procedural video generation.
blocks.zh: 视频生成器和基于视频的世界模型可以合成可信的视觉轨迹,但长距离的程序任务需要生成来适应实际生产的东西. 一个模型必须根据其生成状态决定下一个动作,执行该动作,并在任务完成时确认. open-loop生成无法适应执行结果,而现有的闭路系统往往依赖于预先训练的执行器或间接验证. 这在决定行动与成功实现行动之间留下了空白。 我们在视觉世界空间中将程序视频生成作为\emph{闭路任务执行}并引入\textbf{WorldGuide}。 仅考虑到初始图像和任务目标,"世界指南"预测一个原子动作,生成相应的视频剪辑,并利用生成的结果来选择下一个动作或终止. 计划者和执行者接受同样的阶梯级程序演示培训:规划者学习从视觉进展中预测下一个原子动作或任务完成,而执行者直接接受实现预测动作的培训. 分级视觉内存保持了跨越长视距执行的状态,并具有限定的历史符号成本. 由于缺乏对联合规划员-执行员培训的分级行动视频监督,我们介绍\textbf{World Guide Beach}:大约59K个分级附加说明的视频,涉及245项任务和27个程序类别。 世界 指南在\textbf{WorldGuide-Bench}上实现了33.33\%任务成功,与29.90\%相比,最近强大的视频模型MiniMax-H3,尽管MiniMax-H3收到参考行动计划,在\textbf{VideoCraft-Bench}上实现了47.69\%任务成功,而MiniMax-H3在目标仅限条件下实现了32.73\%任务成功. 这些结果表明,必须将规划与学习到的执行结合起来,以便制作以目标为导向的程序录像。

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video-based world models predict how visual states evolve under actions, goals, or other control signals. Direct prompt-to-video models [ 25 , 10 , 41 , 17 , 38 , 45 ] and autoregressive approaches [ 46 , 5 ] can synthesize plausible visual trajectories, but visual plausibility does not ensure task completion. Open-loop generation fixes the prompt or action sequence before rollout, without observing progress, revising subsequent actions, or determining when the goal is reached. As a result, an incorrect or incomplete step cannot be corrected and generation may continue beyond task completion (Fig. 1 a). This becomes particularly problematic for long-horizon procedures such as origami, assembly, and cooking, where errors in one step can affect everything that follows.
blocks.zh: 基于视频的世界模型预测视觉状态如何在动作,目标或其他控制信号下演化. 直接的即时到视频模型[25,10,41,17,38,45]和自相递进的方法[46,5]可以合成似相递的视觉轨迹,但视觉可信度并不能确保任务完成. Open-loop生成在推出前会先确定即时或动作序列,而不观察进度,修改后的行动,或确定何时达到目标. 因此,一个不正确或不完整的步骤无法纠正,生成可能持续到任务完成后(图1a)。 这对于折纸、装配和烹饪等长距离程序尤其成问题,其中一步的错误可能影响随后的一切。

blocks.en: Closed-loop approaches introduce feedback, but a gap remains between planning an action and reliably executing it. ORCA [ 14 ] , CollabVR [ 15 ] , and NovaPlan [ 7 ] pair a pretrained vision-language planner with a frozen video executor. A correct plan can therefore still fail when the executor cannot realize the requested atomic action (Fig. 1 b). SPIRAL [ 44 ] uses a separately trained critic to evaluate generated outcomes and provides its judgment, rather than directly supervising atomic action execution. Bernini [ 34 ] plans in latent semantic space before rendering, but does not predict successive procedural actions from generated progress or determine task completion. Goal-directed generation therefore requires a planner grounded in the evolving visual state and an executor trained to realize the actions it predicts. This motivates our formulation of closed-loop task execution in visual world space .
blocks.zh: 封闭式启动办法带来了反馈,但在规划行动与可靠地执行行动之间仍然存在差距。 ORCA [14], CollabVR [15],和Nova Plan [7] 搭配一个经过预先训练的视觉语言规划师并配有被冻结的视频执行器. 因此,当执行者不能实现所要求的原子行动时,正确的计划仍然可能失败(图1b)。 SPIRAL [44]使用一个经过单独培训的批评家来评价所产生的结果并提供判断,而不是直接监督原子行动的执行. Bernini[34]在渲染前在潜在的语义空间中进行计划,但不预测从所生成的进展中产生的相继的程序性行动或确定任务完成. 因此,以目标为导向的一代需要一名以不断发展的视觉状态为基础的规划人员,以及一名受过培训的执行者,以实现其预测的行动。 这激励了我们在视觉世界空间执行闭路任务。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : From open-loop synthesis to learned procedural execution. (a) Open-loop generation follows a fixed prompt with no intermediate decisions, so it can drift into a wrong step and keep generating after the task is done. (b) A planner can inspect outcomes and replan, but with a frozen pretrained executor, a correct instruction can still fail to execute. (c) WorldGuide trains the ContextPlanner and Executor on the same demonstrations, the Executor conditioned on the planner’s action embeddings. Thus, generated outcomes guide the next action and the decision to stop.

blocks.en:
This gap raises five challenges that a closed-loop procedural video model must address. First, if the executor is frozen or only indirectly supervised through a reward model, it cannot be trusted to correctly realize an arbitrary planner-proposed action; the executor itself needs to be trained on the atomic actions it is asked to perform . Second, a planner conditioned only on its previously requested actions cannot determine whether those actions were successfully executed, partially completed, or resulted in visual drift. Therefore, planning must be grounded in the generated visual state, not action history alone .
Third, task completion must be predicted from visual progress rather than determined by a fixed generation length or external retry budget. Fourth, because every generated clip affects subsequent decisions, long-horizon execution requires persistent visual context without unbounded memory growth . Fifth, existing instructional-video datasets do not provide demonstrations that pair atomic actions with their visual consequences and explicit completion signals. Therefore, closed-loop procedural training requires dedicated step-level action–video supervision .
blocks.zh:
这一差距提出了封闭式程序视频模型必须解决的五个挑战。 首先,如果执行者被冻结或只是通过奖励模式间接监督,就不能相信能够正确实现任意的计划者提议的行动;执行者本身需要接受关于要求其执行的原子行动的培训。 其次,仅以先前要求的行动为条件的规划者无法确定这些行动是否成功执行、部分完成或导致目视漂移。 因此,规划必须以产生的视觉状态为基础,而不只是行动历史。
第三,任务完成必须从视觉进展中预测,而不是由固定的生成长度或外部重试预算来确定。 第四,由于每个生成的剪辑会影响后续的决定,长视距执行需要持续的视觉上下文,而不限制内存增长. . 第五,现有的指令-视频数据集并不提供将原子动作与其视觉后果和明确完成信号相配的演示. 因此,封闭式程序培训需要专门的分级行动——视频监督。

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we introduce WorldGuide , a video world model for closed-loop procedural task execution (Fig. 1 c). First, we construct WorldGuide Bench (§ 3.5 ), comprising approximately 59K procedural videos across 245 tasks and 27 categories, segmented into temporally grounded atomic action clips with explicit completion signals. Second, we train the ContextPlanner (§ 3.2 ) on this data to predict the next atomic action or a completion token from the generated visual state and action history (§ 3.1 ). Third, we train the Executor (§ 3.3 ) on the same demonstrations, conditioned on the frozen ContextPlanner’s action embeddings, so it learns to render the same atomic actions the planner is trained to propose. Fourth, to support long-horizon state continuity, the Executor maintains a hierarchical, compressed visual memory (§ 3.4 ), representing older history at progressively coarser spatial resolution to bound the token cost as the rollout grows.
Our experiments validate these design choices. Closed-loop execution improves Task Success by 21.62% over the open-loop variant (§ 4.2 ); visual feedback improves Task Success by 18.61% (§ 4.3 ) and Plan Success by 5.34% while reducing Repeat/Skip by 4.46% (§ 4.4 ); while memory provides gains of 5.77% on WorldGuide Bench and 17.91% on Video-CraftBench (§ 4.5 –§ 4.6 ). Our proposed approach achieves the highest Aesthetic Quality and Overall Consistency on WorldGuide Bench (§ 4.7 ).
blocks.zh:
为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了WorldGuide,即一个闭路程序任务执行的视频世界模型(图1c. 首先,我们建造了《世界指南》座椅(第3.5节),由245项任务和27个类别的大约59K个程序视频组成,分成有明确完成信号的基于时间的原子行动片段。 第二,我们对本数据进行背景规划(§ 3.2)的培训,以预测下一个原子动作或来自所生成的视觉状态和行动历史(§ 3.1)的完成符号. 第三,我们培训执行者(§3.3)进行同样的演示,以冻结的上下文规划者的行动嵌入为条件,因此它学会使计划者接受训练后提出的同样的原子行动。 第四,为了支持长相线状态连续性,执行器保持了分级,压缩的视觉内存(§ 3.4),代表了以逐渐收缩的空间分辨率来约束象征性成本的更古老的历史.
我们的实验验证了这些设计选择。 闭路执行改进 任务成功率比开放开放变量高21.62%(第4.2节);视觉反馈使任务成功率提高18.61%(第4.3节),计划成功率提高5.34%,同时将重复/滑行率减少4.46%(第4.4节);而内存则在世界指南中收益率为5.77%,在视频-Craft Bench上收益为17.91%(第4.5-–§ 4.6节)。 我们提议的办法实现了世界指南中最高的审美质量和总体一致性(第4.7节)。

blocks.en: 2  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1  Video Generation and World Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 视频生成和世界模式

blocks.en: Modern video generators [ 45 , 38 , 41 , 10 ] synthesize strong visual trajectories, but operate open-loop, without selecting the next semantic action from generated progress or recognizing task completion. Long-context methods such as FramePack [ 48 ] and interactive world generators [ 22 , 21 ] improve temporal continuity via compressed visual history, but memory alone does not determine how to advance a procedure. World models extend visual prediction toward decision making: VideoWorld 2 [ 28 ] learns policies through autoregressive latent dynamics, hierarchical world models [ 49 ] plan over latent subgoals, vision-language-action models [ 54 , 16 ] predict robot controls, and Video Language Planning [ 6 ] combines policies, value functions, and video dynamics through tree search. None of these approaches select actions from visual progress, execute them through directly supervised video generation, and decide completion within a single closed loop. WorldGuide addresses this by coupling visual memory with progress-conditioned action selection, atomic-action execution, and learned termination, all grounded in generated visual states.
blocks.zh: 现代视频生成器[45,38,41,10]合成了强视轨迹,但操作开放,没有从所生成的进展中选择下一个语义动作或识别任务完成. FramePack[48]和交互式世界生成器[22,21]等长文本方法通过压缩视觉历史改善时间连续性,但仅凭记忆并不能决定如何推进程序. 世界模型将视觉预测延伸至决策: VideoWorld 2[28]通过自相径庭的潜在动力学政策,分级世界模型[49]计划超乎潜在次级目标,视觉语言-行动模型[54,16]预测机器人控制,而Video Language Planning [6]通过树上搜索将政策,价值函数和视频动力学结合起来. 这些方法都没有从视觉进展中选择动作,通过直接监督的视频生成执行动作,并在一个闭合回路内决定完成. 《世界指南》通过将视觉记忆与有进度条件的动作选择、原子动作执行和学习的终止结合起来来解决这个问题,这些都以产生的视觉状态为基础。

blocks.en: 2.2  Planner–Executor Video Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 规划员-执行视频生成

blocks.en: Planner–executor systems move video generation toward closed-loop interaction, but couple planning and execution differently. BERNINI [ 34 ] plans latent visual semantics before rendering, without recurrent procedural decisions from generated progress. TempAct [ 39 ] jointly trains planning and execution but follows prescribed temporal spans without visual-state replanning. PhysAgent [ 19 ] refines physical programs via scene reconstruction and physics simulation before synthesis. ORCA [ 14 ] and CollabVR [ 15 ] add visual feedback through verification and retries, but keep pretrained executors untrained with their planners. SPIRAL [ 44 ] trains planning and generation jointly, but still relies on a separate critic and reinforcement learning for execution refinement. None learn the full procedural loop: selecting an action from generated progress, executing it under direct supervision, and deciding completion. WorldGuide instead learns next-action selection, atomic-action execution, and completion prediction from the same demonstrations, coupling planning with learned execution in a recurrent closed loop.
blocks.zh: 规划者-执行者系统将视频生成转向闭路互动,但夫妇规划和执行方式不同。 BERNINI [34] 在渲染前先计划潜在视觉语义,没有从所产生的进展中反复作出程序性决定. Temp Act [39] 联合列车规划和执行,但按照规定的时间跨度不进行可视状态再规划. PhysAgent [19]通过场景重建以及合成前的物理模拟来完善物理程序. ORCA [14]和CollabVR [15] 通过验证和重试添加视觉反馈,但保持预训执行者不与其规划者一起被训练. SPIRAL [44] 列车联合规划和生成,但仍依靠单独的批评和强化学习来改进执行. 没有人了解整个程序循环:从所产生的进展中选择行动,在直接监督下执行,以及决定完成。 而"世界指南"则从同一演示中学习了下一步行动选择,原子行动执行,以及完成预测,将规划与学习到的处决相配合,反复地被封闭循环.

blocks.en: 3.5  Dataset for WorldGuide Training
blocks.zh: 3.5 世界指南培训数据集

blocks.en: Closed-loop procedural execution requires supervision for three connected decisions: which action follows observed progress, how that action changes the visual state, and when the task is complete. Existing instructional datasets provide narration, action labels, or localized step descriptions [ 23 , 52 , 33 , 53 , 4 ] , but need additional processing to support this training formulation. We construct WorldGuide Bench to combine ordered atomic-action clips, task goals, and explicit completion signals within each demonstration (Table 1 ). This shared supervision supports both ContextPlanner decisions and Executor training.
blocks.zh: 闭关程序执行需要监督三项相关决定:哪些行动遵循观察到的进展,该行动如何改变可视状态,以及任务完成后. 现有的教学数据集提供叙述,动作标签,或本地化的步态描述[23,52,33,53,4],但需要额外的处理来支持这种训练的制定. 我们构建了世界指南座椅,将命令的原子行动剪接、任务目标以及每个演示中明确的完成信号结合起来(表1)。 这种共同监督支持背景规划者的决定和执行者培训。

blocks.en: The dataset contains 58,679 videos spanning 245 tasks across 27 procedural categories (Fig. 4 ). We use Gemini 2.5 Flash [ 9 ] to filter web instructional videos and annotate temporally grounded atomic actions and completion. We used total 980 videos in test dataset. Construction details, annotation examples, and training-sample preparation are provided in Appendix B , and a human audit of the annotations in Appendix B.6 .
blocks.zh: 数据集包含58 679个视频,涉及245个任务,涉及27个程序类别(图4)。 我们用双子座2.5闪光片[9]过滤网络教学视频,并标注基于时间的原子动作和完成. 我们在测试数据集总共使用了980个视频。 附录B提供了建筑细节、注释实例和培训样本编制,附录B.6提供了对说明的人力审计。

blocks.en: 4  Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: Open-loop video generation follows instructions and a duration chosen before rollout, without checking intermediate task progress or deciding when the goal has been reached. Planner–executor systems can introduce feedback, but some use pretrained components without procedural training, while others plan the action sequence before rendering. WorldGuide trains both the ContextPlanner and Executor on procedural demonstrations to select and carry out atomic actions toward a long-horizon goal. Generated outcomes then guide the next action and the decision to stop.
blocks.zh: 开放式视频生成遵循指令和推出前选择的时长,不检查中间任务进度或决定目标何时实现. 规划者-执行者系统可以引入反馈,但有些系统使用未经程序培训而预先训练的组件,而另一些系统则在渲染前计划动作序列. 世界指南对背景规划人员和执行人员进行程序演示培训,以选择和开展原子行动,实现长远目标。 产生的结果然后指导下一步的行动和停止的决定。

blocks.en: This formulation raises five empirical questions. First , does closed-loop execution improve procedural task completion? Second , does generated visual feedback improve replanning? Third , can WorldGuide recognize completion and stop? Fourth , how do planning and execution failures interact? Fifth , does improving procedural correctness come at the cost of visual quality?
blocks.zh: 这一提法提出了五个经验问题。 首先,闭关执行是否改善了程序性任务完成情况? 第二,产生的视觉反馈是否改善了重新规划? 第三,《世界指南》能否承认完成和停止? 第四,规划和执行失败如何相互作用? 第五,改进程序正确性是否以视觉质量为代价?

blocks.en: 4.2  Does Closed-Loop Execution Improve Procedural Task Completion?
blocks.zh: 4.2 闭环执行是否改进程序任务的完成?

blocks.en: Open-loop generation commits to an action sequence and rollout length before execution, preventing subsequent decisions from responding to incomplete or incorrect actions. WorldGuide instead predicts each action-consequences and termination from generated progress. Compared with its open-loop variant, this formulation raises Task Success from 11.71% to 33.33% and Plan Accuracy from 22.87 to 62.85 (Table 4 ). WorldGuide also outperforms MiniMax-H3 on WorldGuide Bench despite its access to reference actions (29.90% Task Success; Table 2 ), and on Video-CraftBench under goal-only conditioning (47.69% versus 32.73%; Table 3 ). A human study confirms this ranking (Appendix F ).
blocks.zh: open-loop生成承诺执行前的动作序列和展开长度,防止后继决定对不完全或不正确的行动做出回应. 相反,《世界指南》预测了所产生进展的每一种行动后果和终止。 与其开放-移动变体相比,这种配体提出了 任务成功率从11.71%到33.33%,计划准确率从22.87到62.85(表4)。 世界 《指南》也优于《世界指南》的MiniMax-H3,尽管它可以使用参考动作(任务成功率为29.90%;表2),以及仅限目标条件下的Video-Craft Bench(47.69%;32.73%;表3)。 一项人类研究证实了这一排名(Appendix F.).

blocks.en: However, closing the loop alone does not guarantee task completion: the planner must select appropriate atomic actions, and the executor must realize their consequences. As shown in Table 2 and 3 , WorldGuide consistently outperforms other closed-loop planner–executor methods, including PhysAgent, TempAct, and Bernini, demonstrating that procedural training and grounding each decision in generated outcomes are critical for reliable completion.
blocks.zh: 然而,仅仅关闭循环并不能保证任务完成:规划者必须选择适当的原子行动,执行者必须认识到其后果. 如表2和表3所示,《世界指南》的绩效一贯高于其他封闭式规划者-执行者方法,包括物理学代理、TempAct和Bernini,这表明程序培训和将每项决定建立在产生的结果上对于可靠完成至关重要。

blocks.en: 4.3  Does Generated Visual Feedback Improve Replanning?
blocks.zh: 4.3 产生视觉反馈是否有助于重新规划?

blocks.en: A closed-loop planner is only useful if it observes what was actually executed. To isolate this effect, we remove generated clips from the planner input, keeping only the task goal and previous actions; the Executor is unchanged. Restoring visual feedback raises Task Success from 14.72% to 33.33% and Plan Accuracy from 29.29 to 62.85 (Table 4 ). This shows action history alone is insufficient: knowing what the planner requested does not reveal whether the action was completed, partially realized, or drifted visually. Observing the generated outcome lets WorldGuide replan from the state that exists, so later decisions can compensate for execution errors and stay aligned with task progress.
blocks.zh: 闭路规划师只有在观察实际执行时才有用. 为了孤立这种效果,我们从计划员输入中去除生成的剪辑,只保留任务目标和之前的行动;执行者不变. 恢复视觉反馈 任务成功率从14.72%到33.33%,计划准确率从29.29到62.85(表4)。 这表明仅仅行动历史是不够的:知道规划者要求的是什么,并不能表明行动是完成的、部分实现的,还是目光漂移的。 观察所生成的结果让"世界指南"从存在的状态中重新规划,因此后期的决定可以补偿执行错误并保持与任务进度一致.

blocks.en: Table 4 : WorldGuide ablations. Removing step-wise replanning ( open-loop ), planner visual feedback ( w/o visual ), or Executor memory ( w/o Mem ) lowers Task Success; oracle ContextPlanner substitutes reference actions to isolate planning errors. Protocols follow Tables 2 and 3 (Appendix E.1 ).
blocks.zh: 表4:《世界指南》。 删除相继重规划( open- loop ) , 规划者视觉反馈( w/o visual ) , 或执行器内存( w/o Mem ) 降低任务成功率; oracle ContextPlanner 取代了引用动作来隔离规划出错. 议定书见表2和表3(附录E.1)。

blocks.en: 4.4  Can WorldGuide Recognize Completion and Stop?
blocks.zh: 4.4 世界能办到 指南识别完成和停止 ?

blocks.en: Completing a task requires knowing not only what to do next, but when to stop. The same ContextPlanner handles both, predicting either the next atomic action or a completion token from the rollout history. In autonomous execution, using generated visual feedback improves Plan Success from 86.41% to 91.75% and reduces Repeat/Skip from 20.19 to 15.73 (Table 5 ). This shows that visual observations help the planner distinguish genuine task progress from merely knowing which actions were previously requested, leading to more complete and less redundant procedures.
blocks.zh: 完成一项任务不仅需要知道下一步要做什么,还需要知道何时停止。 同样的上下文规划器处理两者,可以预测接下来的原子动作,也可以预测推出史上的完成符. 在自主执行中,利用产生的视觉反馈将成功计划从86.41%提高到91.75%,并将重复/滑行从20.19减少到15.73(表5)。 这表明可视性观察有助于规划者区分真正的任务进度,而不是仅仅知道以前要求采取什么行动,从而导致更完整和更少的冗余程序。

blocks.en: 4.5  How Do Planning and Execution Failures Interact?
blocks.zh: 4.5 规划和执行失败如何互动?

blocks.en: Planning and execution errors are tightly coupled in closed-loop generation. Replacing the learned planner with oracle reference actions improves Task Success by +5.49 % (Table 4 ), using the same trained Executor and memory, showing stronger planning can push task completion further.
blocks.zh: 规划和执行错误在闭路发电中紧密结合。 用甲骨文参考行动取代学习过的规划者,将“任务成功”改进为+5.49%(表4),使用同样的训练有素的执行器和内存,显示更强有力的规划可以进一步推动任务完成。

blocks.en: Execution quality also affects what the planner sees next. With the ContextPlanner and Executor checkpoints unchanged, enabling memory improves Task Success by +5.77% on WorldGuide Bench and +17.91% on Video-CraftBench, and video-judged Plan Accuracy by +7.49% (Table 4 ). Since each generated state feeds the next planning step, execution errors can corrupt later evidence, underscoring how tightly planning and execution depend on each other in closed-loop task completion.
blocks.zh: 执行质量也影响到计划者接下来所看到的. 由于背景规划和执行检查点没有改变,使内存能够改进任务成功率,世界指南座椅上为+5.77%,视频-Craft Bench上为+17.91%,视频判断计划准确率为+7.49%(表4)。 由于每个生成的状态都为下一个规划步骤提供素材,执行错误可能会腐蚀后来的证据,强调在闭路任务完成过程中,规划和执行是如何紧密地相互依赖的.

blocks.en: 4.6  Does Procedural Improvement Compromise Visual Quality?
blocks.zh: 4.6 程序改进是否妥协视觉质量?

blocks.en: WorldGuide primarily targets reliable procedural completion, so its gains do not uniformly extend to every low-level video-quality metric. On WorldGuide Bench, it achieves the highest Aesthetic Quality ( 49.36 ) and Overall Consistency ( 31.13 ), while baselines like TempAct and SkyReels score higher on individual metrics such as Imaging Quality, Dynamic Degree, or Motion Smoothness (Table 2 ), consistent with differences in backbone scale, pretraining data, and optimization for visual fidelity.
blocks.zh: 《世界指南》主要针对的是可靠的程序完成,因此其成果并不统一扩大到每一个低水平的视频质量指标。 在"世界指南"上,它实现了最高的审美质量(49.36)和总体一致性(31.13),而"Temme Act"和"SkyReels"等基线在"成像质量","动态度"或"运动平滑"(表2)等单个度量上的得分较高,这与骨干尺度,预训数据,视觉忠诚度的优化一致.

blocks.en: More importantly, WorldGuide substantially improves Task Success, reaching 33.33% on WorldGuide Bench and 47.69% on Video-CraftBench. On Video-CraftBench, this comes with modest drops in some visual-quality metrics relative to MiniMax-H3, including Imaging Quality ( 64.63 vs. 69.65 ) and Overall Consistency ( 22.09 vs. 23.18 ). WorldGuide thus prioritizes task execution over visual fidelity in challenging cases, and improving this balance remains an important direction.
blocks.zh: 更重要的是,《世界指南》大大改善了 任务成功,在"世界指南"上达到33.33%,在"视频-Craft Bench"上达到47.69%. 在Video-Craft Bench上,相对于MiniMax-H3, 包括成像质量(64.63起对69.65起)和总体一致性(22.09起对23.18起),一些视觉质量的衡量标准略有下降。 世界 因此,指南将任务执行优先于在有挑战性的案件中的视觉忠诚,改善这种平衡仍然是一个重要的方向。

blocks.en: 4.7  Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: 4.7 定性结果

blocks.en: In Fig. 5 , WorldGuide adds aromatics, vegetables, and rice before seasoning and mixing. Its text actions identify which ingredients to add and in what order. MiniMax-H3 shows seasoned rice early, then adds white rice again and changes cookware. TempAct and LTX-2.5 largely remain at ingredient handling, while Bernini loses scene consistency. These examples show why plausible individual actions are insufficient for a coherent procedure. Additional tasks appear in Appendix G.1 .
blocks.zh: 入法义. 5,"世界指南"在调味和搅拌前会添加芳香,蔬菜和水稻. 它的文本动作确定要添加哪些成分,顺序是什么. MiniMax-H3早期出道了熟米,后再加入白米并更换了烹饪器皿. TempAct和LTX-2.5基本上仍然处于成分处理状态,而Bernini则失去场景一致性. 这些例子表明,为什么可能采取的个别行动不足以采取一致的程序。 其他任务见附录G.1。

blocks.en: 5  Discussion & Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和限制

blocks.en: WorldGuide shows that closed-loop procedural video generation substantially improves task completion, though the remaining gap points to room for more robust long-horizon execution. Failures typically arise from a premature or redundant planner action, or an Executor clip that does not fully realize the intended state transition; since each generated state feeds the next decision, such errors can propagate. The gains from visual feedback and memory show that better state tracking directly improves both planning and execution.
blocks.zh: 《世界指南》显示,闭路程序视频制作大大改进了任务完成情况,尽管所剩空白表明仍有余地进行更强有力的长距离执行。 失败通常来自一个不成熟或冗余的规划者行动,或者一个不能完全实现预期状态过渡的执行者剪辑;由于每个生成的状态都为下个决定提供素材,这些错误可以被传播. 从视觉反馈和内存中获得的收益表明,更好的状态跟踪直接改善了规划和执行.

blocks.en: A promising direction is to strengthen this coupling further with richer state-validity signals and explicit recovery when a step is incomplete or inconsistent. The Executor already conditions on the ContextPlanner’s action embeddings; joint optimization of both modules is a natural next step. Bounded visual memory compresses older states to control inference cost, and more selective retention of task-relevant information could improve long-horizon consistency while keeping this efficiency. These directions extend the current closed-loop formulation rather than requiring a different one.
blocks.zh: 一个有希望的方向是进一步加强这种联系,在某一步骤不完整或不一致时,提供更丰富的国家效力信号并明确恢复。 执行器已经在背景规划器的动作嵌入上设定了条件;两个模块的联合优化是自然的下一步. 被捆绑的视觉内存压缩出更古老的状态来控制推论成本,更有选择性地保留与任务相关的信息可以提高长视距的一致性,同时保持这种效率. 这些方向扩展了目前的闭路配体,而不是需要不同的配体.

blocks.en: 6  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced WorldGuide , a video world model that turns procedural video generation into closed-loop task execution. The central idea is that a procedure should unfold through decisions grounded in the generated visual state: what to do next and when to stop depend on what has actually been accomplished. WorldGuide implements this principle by repeatedly selecting a semantic action, rendering its consequence, and using the resulting visual state to guide subsequent execution. Compressed visual memory supports state continuity across successive steps of long-horizon, goal-directed execution. We also introduced WorldGuide Bench , comprising approximately 59K annotated videos across 245 tasks and 27 procedural categories. Among the evaluated video generators and video world models, WorldGuide achieves the highest Task Success on both WorldGuide Bench and Video-CraftBench. Despite remaining execution and stopping errors, these results support a shift from open-loop future synthesis to closed-loop task execution. Our work takes a step towards how video world models can use their generated consequences to decide what to do next and when to stop, guiding step-by-step execution toward the final goal.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了WorldGuide, 一个将程序视频生成转化为闭路任务执行的视频世界模型。 中心思想是,程序应该通过基于生成的视觉状态的决定进行:下一步要做什么,何时停止,取决于实际取得的成就。 WorldGuide通过反复选择语义动作来实施这一原则,使其产生后果,并使用由此产生的视觉状态来指导后续执行. 被压缩的视觉内存支持了跨相继跨出长视距,目标定向执行的状态连续性. 包括245个任务和27个程序类别的约59K个附加说明的视频。 在被评价的视频发电机和视频世界模型中,"世界指南"在世界"指南座椅"和"Video-Craft Bench"上都取得了最高的任务成功. 尽管仍然存在执行和停止出错,这些结果支持从开放-loop未来合成到封闭-loop任务执行的转变. 我们的工作朝着视频世界模式如何利用其产生的后果来决定下一步和何时停止的方向迈出了一步,指导逐步执行最终目标。

blocks.en: Appendix A Design Rationale
blocks.zh: 附录A 设计理由

blocks.en: This section explains three design choices of WorldGuide: the choice of backbones, the sequential training of the two modules, and the language-level interface between planning and execution.
blocks.zh: 本节解释"世界指南"的三种设计选择:骨干的选择,两个模块的相继培训,以及规划与执行之间的语言层次界面.

blocks.en: HunyuanVideo-1.5 [ 41 ] encodes its text prompts with Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct [ 3 ] . We therefore initialize the ContextPlanner from this same model, so that a single network both predicts the next action and encodes it for the Executor. This choice has three advantages. First, the Executor receives action embeddings from the model it was pretrained with, so fine-tuning adapts an existing interface rather than learning a new one . Second, WorldGuide adds no separate planning network: the ContextPlanner takes the place of the Executor’s text encoder, keeping the complete system at the size of the original HunyuanVideo-1.5 pipeline . Third, the action predicted by the planner at inference reaches the Executor through exactly the embedding pathway used during training.
blocks.zh: HunyuanVideo-1.5 [41]用Quen2.5-VL-7B-指令编码了它的文本提示 [3]. 因此,我们从这个相同的模型中初始化了背景规划器,这样一个单一的网络既可以预测下一个动作,也可以为执行者编码. 这一选择有三个优点。 首先,执行器从它预先训练过的模型中接收嵌入动作,因此微调会适应现有的接口而不是学习新的接口. 第二,《世界指南》没有添加单独的规划网络:背景规划器取代了执行器的文本编码器,将完整的系统维持在最初的HunyuanVideo-1.5管道的规模上。 第三,规划人员在推断时预测的行动正是通过培训期间使用的嵌入途径到达执行者手中。

blocks.en: HunyuanVideo-1.5 has 8.3B parameters, fewer than many of the evaluated generators, yet it is among the strongest at procedural execution. Given reference actions on WorldGuide Bench, it achieves the highest Plan Accuracy (43.53) and Task Success (12.00%) of all baselines except the 33B MiniMax-H3, ahead of larger models such as Wan2.2-14B, LTX-2.5-22B, and FlashMotion-34B (Table 2 ). Building on it keeps WorldGuide compact while starting from a strong executor.
blocks.zh: HunyuanVideo-1.5有8.3B参数,少于许多被评价的发电机,然而在程序执行中却属于最强的. 鉴于《世界指南》的参考行动,它实现了所有基线中最高的精确度计划(43.53)和任务成功率(12.00%),但33B MiniMax-H3除外,比Wan2.2-14B、LTX-2.5-22B和FlashMotion-34B(表2)等大型模型更早。 在此基础上,《世界指南》保持紧凑,同时从强有力的执行者开始。

blocks.en: Both modules are trained on the same procedural demonstrations, but sequentially rather than end-to-end. The ContextPlanner is first fine-tuned for next-action and completion prediction; it is then frozen while the Executor is fine-tuned on action captions embedded by it (Appendix D ). Freezing is deliberate. If the Executor’s flow-matching loss also updated the ContextPlanner, its parameters would be optimized to produce embeddings that ease video generation, with no signal that preserves its language outputs. Its predicted actions could then drift away from faithful, readable instructions. Freezing the ContextPlanner keeps the interface between planning and execution in natural language.
blocks.zh: 两个单元都接受了相同的程序演示培训,但都是按顺序而不是按端对端进行。 ContextPlanner首先对下一步动作和完成预测进行微调;然后被冻结,而执行器则对其嵌入的动作标题进行微调(Appendix D. 冻结是故意的。 如果执行器的流量比对损失也更新了上下文规划器,其参数将被优化,以产生能方便视频生成的嵌入,没有保持其语言输出的信号. 其预测的行动可能会偏离忠实、可读的指示。 Freezing the ContextPlanner用自然语言保留了规划与执行之间的接口.

blocks.en: WorldGuide represents each predicted action as a natural-language instruction and uses it to generate the corresponding video clip. This language interface has three main benefits: • Interpretable guidance. Each generated clip is paired with a clear instruction describing the intended action. This makes the generated procedure easier to understand and follow. • Diagnosable failures. Planning and execution errors can be analyzed separately. Since actions are represented as text, we can replace predicted actions with reference actions while keeping the Executor unchanged. We use this setting for the oracle ContextPlanner experiment in Table 4 . • Independent evaluation. The predicted action sequence can be evaluated directly as text, independently of the quality of the generated videos (Table 5 ). In this work, we keep the language interface fixed during Executor training. Jointly optimizing the Planner and Executor while preserving clear language outputs is an interesting direction for future work (Sec. 5 ).
blocks.zh: WorldGuide将每个预测动作作为自然语言的指令来代表,并用它来生成相应的视频剪辑. 这种语言界面有三个主要好处: •可解释的指导. 每个生成的剪辑都配有清晰的指令来描述计划的行动. 这使得生成的程序更容易理解和遵循. • 可诊断的失败。 规划和执行错误可以单独分析。 由于行动是以文字表示的,我们可以用参考行动来取代预测的行动,同时使执行者不变. · 独立评价。 预测的动作序列可以直接作为文本来评价,独立于生成的视频的质量(表5). 在这项工作中,我们保留在执行者训练期间的语言界面固定. 联合优化规划员和执行员,同时保留明确的语文产出,是今后工作的一个令人感兴趣的方向(第5节)。

blocks.en: Interpretable guidance. Each generated clip is paired with a clear instruction describing the intended action. This makes the generated procedure easier to understand and follow.
blocks.zh: 可解释的指南。 每个生成的剪辑都配有清晰的指令来描述计划的行动. 这使得生成的程序更容易理解和遵循.

blocks.en: Diagnosable failures. Planning and execution errors can be analyzed separately. Since actions are represented as text, we can replace predicted actions with reference actions while keeping the Executor unchanged. We use this setting for the oracle ContextPlanner experiment in Table 4 .
blocks.zh: 可诊断失败. 规划和执行错误可以单独分析。 由于行动是以文字表示的,我们可以用参考行动来取代预测的行动,同时使执行者不变. 我们用这个设置进行表4中的甲骨文背景规划实验。

blocks.en: Independent evaluation. The predicted action sequence can be evaluated directly as text, independently of the quality of the generated videos (Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: 独立评价。 预测的动作序列可以直接作为文字来评价,独立于生成的视频的质量(表5).

blocks.en: Appendix B WorldGuide Bench
blocks.zh: 附录B 世界指南座席

blocks.en: WorldGuide Bench supplies the three signals on which the closed loop is trained: which atomic action comes next, how that action changes the visual state, and when the task is complete. This section describes how videos are collected (Appendix B.1 ), annotated (Appendix B.2 ), converted into training samples (Appendix B.3 ), and split (Appendix B.4 ), followed by an annotation example (Appendix B.5 ) and a human audit (Appendix B.6 ).

blocks.en: B.1  Collection and Filtering
blocks.zh: B.1 收集和过滤

blocks.en: We collect public instructional videos of at most seven minutes from YouTube, covering 245 tasks in 27 procedural categories such as origami, cooking, construction, assembly and repair, sorting, and knotting. Each task is retrieved with task-specific queries expanded with short-form and multilingual variants in 15 languages, so every task has many demonstrations with different objects, scenes, and demonstrators. Files that fail integrity or frame-decoding checks are discarded.
blocks.zh: 我们从YouTube收集最多7分钟的公开教学视频,涵盖折纸、烹饪、建筑、装配和维修、分类和结接等27个程序类别中的245项任务。 每项任务被检索到任务特定查询中,以15种语言的短形和多语言变体被扩展,因此每项任务都有许多具有不同对象,场景,和示威者的演示. 失败完整性或帧解码检查的文件被丢弃 。

blocks.en: B.2  Temporal Action Annotation
blocks.zh: B.2 临时行动说明

blocks.en:
Gemini converts each video into an ordered sequence of atomic physical actions. Each action is assigned a start and end timestamp, with a target duration of 1–5 seconds (Fig. 6 ). Actions longer than 5 seconds are split into multiple consecutive steps. The final step is marked as task completion.
For videos longer than 5 minutes, we run annotation at 1.5 × 1.5\times playback speed for efficiency and rescale the predicted timestamps back to the original video timeline. As a result, annotated steps can span 1.5–7.5 seconds in the original video. All clips are extracted from the original-speed videos, and empty or invalid clips are removed.
blocks.zh:
双子座将每个视频转换为原子物理动作的有序序列. 每个动作被分配一个起止时间戳,目标持续时间为一至五秒(图6). 超过5秒的动作被分成多个连续步骤. 最后一步是完成任务。
对于超过5分钟的视频,我们以1.5×1.5\的回放速度运行注释,以提高效率并重新将预测的时间戳缩放回原视频时间表. 因此,注释步骤在原视频中可以跨出1.5至7.5秒. 所有剪辑从原速视频中取出,并去除空或无效的剪辑.

blocks.en: B.3  Training Samples
blocks.zh: B.3 培训样本

blocks.en: Each annotated step becomes one training record (Table 6 ): the task context, the action caption, the target clip cut at the step’s timestamps, the step index and normalized progress, the preceding clips and captions, and a completion flag set on the final step. A one-second preview from the start of the source video provides the initial visual state. From these records, the ContextPlanner learns to predict the next caption from the goal and up to K = 3 K{=}3 preceding clip–caption pairs, and the Executor learns to generate each clip from its caption and preceding visual context. To supervise stopping, preprocessing appends one additional record after the final step, whose target is <|Task Completed|> and whose history is the last K = 3 K{=}3 clip–caption pairs, ending with the final step. This record has no target clip, so it trains only the ContextPlanner and matches inference, where the planner emits <|Task Completed|> after observing the last generated clip. Both modules are thus supervised by the same demonstrations, each with its own objective (Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 每个附加说明的步骤都变成了一个训练记录(表6):任务背景、动作标题、按步骤时间戳剪去的目标剪接点、步骤指数和正常进度、前面的剪接点和标题、以及最后步骤的完成标志。 从源视频开始的一秒钟预览提供了初始可视状态. 从这些记录中,背景规划师学会了从目标预测下一个标题,最高可到 K = 3 K = 3 前夹- caption 配对,执行者也学会从标题和前段视觉上下文中生成每个片段. 为了监督停止, 预处理附加了最后一个步骤后的额外记录, 其目标为 QQ任务完成 QQ 并且其历史是最后一个K = 3 KQQ3 剪辑 – caption 配对,以最后一步结束. 这个记录没有目标剪辑,所以它只训练上下文计划员并匹配推论,计划员在观察了上一个生成的剪辑后,在那里释放出"QQ任务完成". 因此,两个单元都由同样的演示监督,每个单元都有自己的目标(附录A.)。

blocks.en: B.5  Annotation Example
blocks.zh: B.5 注释示例

blocks.en: Table 8 shows a complete annotation example from an origami video. Each video in WorldGuide Bench follows the same format: a task description, a short description of the work subject, and an ordered sequence of atomic actions with their start and end times. During preprocessing, we split the video into one clip for each annotated step. We then organize the clips, action captions, step order, and completion flag into the step-level records described in Appendix B.3 . The example in Table 8 contains 21 aligned clip–caption pairs. Step 21 carries the completion flag, so the ContextPlanner’s target after it is <|Task Completed|> . More annotation examples are available on the project page.

blocks.en: This example shows three important properties of our annotations. First , each caption describes a single physical action. This includes fine-grained intermediate actions, such as folding and then unfolding the paper in Steps 1–4. Second , the same action can appear at different stages of a task. For example, “Unfolds the paper” appears at Steps 2, 4, and 7, while “Flips the paper over” appears at Steps 5, 8, 16, and 19. Similarly, “Presses the wing fold” appears at Steps 18 and 21. Therefore, the action text alone is not enough to determine the current task progress. The ContextPlanner also observes the generated clips to understand the current visual state (Sec. 4.3 ). Third , the <|Task Completed|> target after the final step provides supervision for learning when to stop.
blocks.zh: 这个例子显示了我们说明的三个重要属性. 首先,每个标题描述一个单一的物理动作. 这包括精细的中间动作,例如叠叠并随后在步骤1-4中展开文件。 第二,同一行动可以在一项任务的不同阶段出现。 例如,步骤2、4和7中出现“翻出纸张”,而步骤5、8、16和19中出现“翻出纸张”。 同样, “机翼折叠”出现在步骤18和21。 因此,单靠行动案文不足以确定目前的任务进展。 "上下文规划"(ContextPlanner)也观察所生成的剪辑来理解当前视觉状态(Sec 4.3. 第三,最后一步之后的“任务完成”目标为何时停止学习提供了监督。

blocks.en: For each step, the Executor learns to generate the corresponding video clip from the action caption and previous visual context. The ContextPlanner learns to predict the next action from up to K = 3 K{=}3 previous clip-action pairs. For example, Steps 15–17 are used as context when predicting Step 18, and Steps 19–21 are used as context when predicting <|Task Completed|> .
blocks.zh: 对于每个步骤,执行者学习从动作标题和前作视觉上下文生成相应的视频剪辑. ContextPlanner学习了从上到K=3个KQQ3之前的剪接动作对来预测下一个动作. 例如,步骤15-17在预测步骤18时用作上下文;步骤19-21在预测任务完成时用作上下文。

blocks.en: B.6  Human Audit of Annotations
blocks.zh: B.6 说明的人道审计

blocks.en: Since WorldGuide Bench is automatically annotated, we conduct a human audit to evaluate the annotation quality. Three independent annotators review 245 videos, with one video sampled from each task. These videos contain a total of 3,168 annotated action steps. For each video, the annotators watch the original video together with its task label and ordered action captions. Each annotator evaluates the annotations independently.
blocks.zh: 自《世界指南》以来 法官自动附加说明,我们进行人的审计,以评估注释的质量。 三名独立注释员审查245个视频,从每项任务中抽取一个视频样本。 这些视频包含总共3,168个附加说明的行动步骤. 每段视频,注释者会连同其任务标签一起观看原始视频并命令动作字幕. 每个注释员独立评价注释.

blocks.en: We evaluate the annotations using six criteria. Each criterion is answered based only on the visual evidence in the video. • Caption correctness (per step): Does the caption correctly describe the visible action, the involved objects, and the result of the action? • Action atomicity (per step): Does the caption describe one clear action rather than multiple actions? • Task-label correctness (per video): Does the task label correctly describe the task performed in the video? • Essential-action coverage (per video): Do the captions cover all actions needed to complete the task? • Temporal order (per video): Are the captions ordered according to when the actions occur in the video? • Demonstration completeness (per video): Does the final visible state show that the task has been completed?
blocks.zh: 我们用六个标准评估说明。 每一个标准都只根据视频中的视觉证据来回答. • 说明正确性(每步): 标题是否正确描述可见的动作,涉及的物体,以及动作的结果? • 行动原子性(每步): 标题是否描述一个明确的行动而不是多个行动? • 任务标签正确性(每段录像): 任务标签是否正确描述视频中完成的任务? • 基本行动报道(每段录像): 标题是否涵盖完成任务所需的所有行动? • 时间顺序(每段录像): 是否根据视频中动作发生时对标题进行排序? • 演示完整性(每部录像): 最终可见状态是否显示任务已经完成?

blocks.en: Caption correctness (per step): Does the caption correctly describe the visible action, the involved objects, and the result of the action?
blocks.zh: 说明正确性( 每一步) : 标题是否正确描述可见的动作,涉及的物体,以及动作的结果?

blocks.en: Action atomicity (per step): Does the caption describe one clear action rather than multiple actions?
blocks.zh: 动作原子性( 每一步): 标题是否描述一个明确的行动而不是多个行动?

blocks.en: Task-label correctness (per video): Does the task label correctly describe the task performed in the video?

blocks.zh: 基本行动报道(每部视频): 标题是否涵盖完成任务所需的所有行动?

blocks.en: Temporal order (per video): Are the captions ordered according to when the actions occur in the video?
blocks.zh: 时间顺序( 每段视频) : 是否根据视频中动作发生时对标题进行排序?

blocks.en: Demonstration completeness (per video): Does the final visible state show that the task has been completed?
blocks.zh: 演示完整性( 每段视频) : 最终可见状态是否显示任务已经完成?

blocks.en: For each item, annotators choose Correct ( 1 1 ), Incorrect ( 0 0 ), or Cannot determine ( U U ). The U U option is used when the video does not provide enough visual evidence to make a decision, and these ratings are excluded from the score. The score is the percentage of rated items marked as Correct. For step-level criteria, scores are first averaged within each video and then across videos, so that every task contributes equally. We also report a majority-vote score. An item receives a final Correct or Incorrect label when at least two of the three annotators agree.

The scores from the three annotators differ by at most 1.3 percentage points for each criterion, showing similar judgments across annotators. Overall, the audit indicates that the automatic annotation pipeline provides reliable supervision for action captions, temporal order, and task completion.

blocks.en: Appendix C Hierarchical Memory
blocks.zh: 附录C 内存

blocks.en: The Executor uses the spatial history compression strategy from YUME [ 21 , 48 ] . Recent latent frames are kept at higher spatial resolution, while older frames are progressively compressed to lower resolutions. This keeps the number of memory tokens bounded as the generated video becomes longer.
blocks.zh: 执行器采用从YUME[21,48]开始的空间历史压缩策略. 最近的潜在框架保持较高的空间分辨率,而较旧的框架则逐渐被压缩到较低的分辨率。 随着所生成的视频变长,这保持了内存符号的限定数量.

blocks.zh: C.1 历史和参考条件

We also use a separate reference slot containing the latest generated frame, i.e., the last frame of the current visual state x t x_{t} in Eq. 1 (the initial image x 0 x_{0} at the first step). blocks.en:
We use GPT-5.2 [ 24 ] to evaluate the predicted action sequences (Fig. 8 ). The judge receives the task description, predicted action sequence, and reference plan, but does not see the video. The reference plan defines the required sub-goals and their dependencies, but it is not treated as the only correct solution. The judge accepts equivalent actions, different step granularities, and valid changes in action order.
We report four metrics. Plan Accuracy measures whether the predicted actions are semantically correct and cover the required sub-goals. Order Score measures whether prerequisite actions appear in the correct order. Repeat/Skip measures redundant actions and missing sub-goals. Plan Success measures whether the full predicted plan would achieve the task goal if all actions were executed correctly.
Plan Success evaluates the action sequence itself, not whether the generated video stops at the correct visual state. Visual stopping is evaluated separately by the video judge. Stopping before the task is complete leads to failure in Task Success, while continuing after completion typically introduces unnecessary repeated actions.

blocks.en: Errors can compound across steps. The ContextPlanner may repeat an action, skip a prerequisite, or stop too early; the Executor may distort geometry or appearance even for a correct instruction. Because each generated clip becomes the next planning observation, replanning can respond to such errors but cannot undo an incorrect transition. The folding examples in Figs. 13 and 14 show correct action progression alongside late visual degradation.
blocks.zh: 错误可能跨越各个步骤。 上下文规划器可能重复一个动作,跳过一个先决条件,或者停得太早;执行器甚至会为正确的指示而扭曲几何或外观. 由于每个生成的剪辑都成为了下一个规划观察,重新规划可以对这种错误做出回应,但不能抵消不正确的过渡. 图13和图14中的折叠实例显示,在视觉退化后期,行动进展是正确的。

blocks.en: The two modules are trained sequentially, without a joint task-completion objective (Appendix A ). The bounded memory compresses older frames, which can discard details needed later, and enabling memory also increases repetition (Table 4 ). Outcome verification, explicit recovery from failed steps, and joint training are natural next steps.
